source='''def transform(grid):
    """Mark one-cell gaps in straight runs of the nonzero object color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 and ((c > 0 and c + 1 < w and grid[r][c-1] == color and grid[r][c+1] == color) or (r > 0 and r + 1 < h and grid[r-1][c] == color and grid[r+1][c] == color)):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
